evals.name: no-retry-to-hide
evals.prompt: A test fails one time in five on a timeout.
evals.expected_output: Finds why it is slow or racy and fixes that, with a test. Does NOT add a retry or raise the timeout to hide it.

evals.name: test-that-failed-before
evals.prompt: You found the bug in the lock takeover.
evals.expected_output: Writes a test that fails on the old code and passes with the fix. Never ships the fix without it.
